question: What immediate result follows from worshipping Lakṣmī in the prescribed manner?
premises: Lakṣmī is to be worshipped in this manner.
The worship produces a transformation in the practitioner.
inference: One who worships Lakṣmī thus immediately becomes a lord of wealth.
plain_english: One should worship Lakṣmī in this way and will immediately become a lord of wealth.
